observations: Photo 0 shows six compact digital cameras arranged in two rows on a wooden surface.
Top row: pink Fujifilm, silver Samsung, black Samsung.
Bottom row: blue Fujifilm, silver Casio, silver Canon.
All cameras have visible lens caps and wrist straps attached.
The Fujifilm models have '14x' printed on the lens ring, suggesting 14x optical zoom.
The Samsung models have 'DIGIMAX L25' printed on the top.
The Casio model has 'Tubia' printed on the front.
The Canon model has 'Canon' printed on the front.
Photo 1 shows the back of the same six cameras, with visible buttons, dials, and screens.
The Fujifilm models have 'FUJIFILM' printed on the back.
The Samsung models have 'SAMSUNG' printed on the back.
The Casio model has 'CASIO' printed on the back.
The Canon model has 'CANON' printed on the back.
All cameras appear to be used, with visible wear and scratches on the bodies and lenses.
No screen is lit in either photo, so functionality cannot be confirmed.

claims.claim: These are UK Used (Tokumbo) pocket size Digital Cameras.
claims.evidence: The term 'UK Used (Tokumbo)' is not verifiable from the photos. No proof of origin or condition beyond visible wear.

claims.claim: Available in Sony, Canon, Nikon, Panasonic...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows Fujifilm, Samsung, Casio, and Canon, not Sony, Nikon, or Panasonic.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Cameras may not power on or function properly.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turning on, screen displaying, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lenses may be scratched, dirty, or damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens glass from multiple angles.

risks.risk: Internal damage or sensor issues (e.g., dead pixels, fogging).
risks.proof: Photo of the camera screen displaying a white or black image to check for defects.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential sensor issues

risks.risk: Battery or charger not included or non-functional.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the camera powering on with battery.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing battery or charger

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photos of the lens glass from multiple angles.
Photo of the camera screen displaying a white or black image to check for defects.
Photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the camera powering on with battery.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
